title: Holding the point
kind: main
faction: commonwealth
---

Storyline 1 in `story/storylines.md`. A backwater community lives around a
jump point on the edge of lawless space. Whoever holds the point controls
its trade, its safety and its news.

This sample models its open act (the supply run), its crossroads (the
organizer's offer, after the first failure) and the first committed beat
(taking the point).
